# AlignPosition

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("AlignPosition")`

Pulls `Attachment0` toward a position and holds it there. Use it for a pet that hovers at a shoulder, a platform that returns to its post or an object being carried. The target is `Position`, or `Attachment1` when `Mode` is `TwoAttachment`.

It pulls with up to `MaxForce` and no faster than `MaxVelocity`. A load heavier than the force can hold sags below the target.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ApplyAtCenterOfMass` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the force is applied at the part's center of mass instead of at the attachment. When it is off, a pull at a corner also turns the part. |
| `Damping` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How strongly the constraint resists motion, in newton seconds per meter. Used together with `Stiffness`. Critical damping, which reaches the target without overshooting, is `2 * math.sqrt(Stiffness * m)` for a mass of `m` kilograms. Less overshoots and oscillates; more arrives slowly. |
| `MaxForce` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | The largest force the constraint can apply, in newtons, along each world axis. With `ReactionForceEnabled`, the axes are those of `Attachment1`. |
| `MaxVelocity` | `number` | `100000` | read/write | The highest speed at which the attachment is moved toward the target, in meters per second. Used only when `Stiffness` is 0. Near the target, the spring takes over. |
| `Mode` | `Enum.PositionAlignmentMode` | `Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment` | read/write | Whether the target is `Position` (`OneAttachment`) or `Attachment1` (`TwoAttachment`). |
| `Position` | `vector` | `vector.create(0, 0, 0)` | read/write | For `OneAttachment`: the position in world space to pull toward. |
| `ReactionForceEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | For `TwoAttachment`: whether an equal and opposite force is applied to the part that `Attachment1` is on. When it is off, the target is not disturbed by what follows it. |
| `Responsiveness` | `number` | `10` | read/write | How quickly the constraint closes the distance to the target, as a frequency in radians per second. Used only when `Stiffness` is 0. A low value drifts in; a high value snaps. The part arrives without overshooting. The value suits a single part; for a part with others jointed to it, set `Stiffness` instead. |
| `RigidityEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the constraint moves the part to the target as fast as the simulation allows, ignoring the force and speed limits. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The strength of the spring that pulls the part to the target, in newtons per meter. At 0, `Responsiveness` is used instead. Above 0, this and `Damping` set the response. For a load of `m` kilograms, `w * w * m` gives a response of `w` radians per second. |
